firm_data.firm_description: The Bronx District Attorney's Office is committed to serving the over 1.4 million members of the Bronx County community through the Office’s groundbreaking mission of “Pursuing Justice with Integrity,” by fulfilling our duty to victims and providing fairness to defendants.
notable_facts: Darcel D. Clark is the first woman and first African-American woman to be elected as District Attorney in New York State

email.subject: AI for Bronx DA — built for high-volume prosecution
email.body:
Hi Sony,

With 616 prosecutors handling 1.4 million residents across the Bronx, your office faces the same challenge most public prosecution shops do: massive caseloads with finite resources. Under DA Clark's leadership, you're pursuing justice with integrity—but tech infrastructure often lags.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for legal teams operating at scale with lean operations. We recently raised $5M, and prosecution offices across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we focus on what matters: case management precision, evidence handling integrity, and enabling your team to focus on justice outcomes, not administrative overhead.

We're expanding in the Northeast and would value a conversation about how we're helping similar offices compete with their case backlogs. Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
